senses.english: To make great and persistent effort towards a goal.
senses.chinese: 為了達成某個目標而持續地、費力地努力。

senses.english: To struggle against someone or something; to contend.
senses.chinese: 與人或環境對抗、較勁。

example.english: She strove to finish the report before midnight.
example.chinese: 她拚了命想在午夜前把報告趕完。

senses.english: To throw something with force and without concern for where it lands.
senses.chinese: 使勁把東西扔出去，也不管它落到哪裡。

senses.english: An exclamation of excitement, approval or triumph.
senses.chinese: 興奮、得意或叫好時喊的一聲。

example.english: He yeeted his backpack onto the sofa and collapsed.
example.chinese: 他把背包往沙發上一扔，整個人癱了下去。

senses.english: Charm or skill in attracting a romantic partner.
senses.chinese: 吸引對象的魅力或手腕。

senses.english: To attract or charm someone romantically.
senses.chinese: 把某人撩到手。

example.english: He has no rizz at all, but he keeps trying.
example.chinese: 他完全不會撩，但還是一直試。

senses.english: The act of continuing to scroll through bad news online even though it makes you feel worse.
senses.chinese: 明知看了只會更難受，還是一直往下滑壞消息的行為。

example.english: I lost two hours to doomscrolling before bed.
example.chinese: 我睡前滑壞消息，兩個小時就這樣沒了。

senses.english: The gradual decline of an online platform, as it squeezes value first out of its users and then out of the businesses that depend on it.
senses.chinese: 網路平台逐步變爛的過程：先從使用者身上榨取價值，再回頭榨依賴它的商家。

example.english: Every social network seems to follow the same path of enshittification.
example.chinese: 每個社群網站好像都走上同一條劣化的路。

senses.english: The dulling of a person's mind, imagined as an illness, from spending too long on trivial online content.
senses.chinese: 網路上沒營養的東西看太久，腦袋像生了病一樣變得遲鈍。

senses.english: Online content of the kind thought to cause this: silly, low-quality, and hard to stop watching.
senses.chinese: 指會讓人變這樣的內容：無聊、粗製濫造，卻又讓人一直滑下去。

example.english: Three hours of brainrot later, he could not name a single thing he had watched.
example.chinese: 滑了三個小時的廢片，他連自己看過什麼都說不出來。

senses.english: Demonstrating thought or careful consideration.
senses.chinese: 展現出思考或審慎考量的。

senses.english: Demonstrating kindness or consideration for others.
senses.chinese: 展現出對他人的善意或體貼的。

example.english: Preparing dinner is a thoughtful gesture for a new mother.
example.chinese: 為剛當媽媽的人準備晚餐，是一個體貼的舉動。

senses.english: Security against electronic attacks such as cyberwarfare.
senses.chinese: 防範網路戰等電子攻擊的安全措施。

senses.english: Something transposed from a thought to a document; the written account of an idea.
senses.chinese: 將想法轉化為文件的內容；以文字記錄下來的構想。

senses.english: Documentary evidence and sources.
senses.chinese: 書面證據與資料來源。

senses.english: Documents that explain the operation of a particular machine or software program.
senses.chinese: 說明特定機器或軟體程式如何操作的文件。

senses.english: Comments that explain the usage of individual functions, libraries and blocks of code.
senses.chinese: 說明個別函式、程式庫及程式碼區塊用法的註解。

senses.english: Conformity or harmony.
senses.chinese: 一致或協調。

senses.english: Charge or care.
senses.chinese: 保管或照料。

example.english: The foreground of this painting is not in keeping.

senses.english: To continue to have something rather than give it up or throw it away.
senses.chinese: 繼續擁有某個東西，沒有交出去也沒有丟掉。

senses.english: To cause someone or something to stay in a particular state or place.
senses.chinese: 讓某個人或某個東西維持在某種狀態或某個位置。

senses.english: To store something in a particular place, so that it can be found there again.
senses.chinese: 把東西固定放在某個地方，下次還找得到。

senses.english: To do what one promised, or to observe a rule or an appointment.
senses.chinese: 說到做到；遵守規定或守住約定。

example.english: She kept the receipt in case the shoes did not fit.
example.chinese: 她把收據留著，怕鞋子穿不下。

senses.english: A land area free of woodland, cities, and towns; open country.
senses.chinese: 沒有森林、城市或城鎮的土地；鄉野。

senses.english: A wide, open space that is usually used to grow crops or to hold farm animals.
senses.chinese: 通常用來種植作物或飼養牲畜的寬廣空地。

senses.english: A place where competitive matches are carried out.
senses.chinese: 舉行競賽的場地。

senses.english: To answer; to address.
senses.chinese: 回答或處理問題。

example.english: She will field questions immediately after her presentation.
example.chinese: 她會在簡報結束後立刻回答問題。

senses.english: To keep (a physical object that one has obtained) to oneself rather than giving it back to its owner.
senses.chinese: 將取得的實體物品留在自己手中，不歸還物主。

senses.english: To keep (information, assent etc) to oneself rather than revealing it.
senses.chinese: 不透露資訊、同意等。

senses.english: To stay back.
senses.chinese: 留在後方；退縮不前。

senses.english: (object pronoun) The people spoken, or written to, as an object.
senses.chinese: 受格代名詞，指被說話或書寫對象所指的多個人；你們。

senses.english: (object pronoun) The person spoken to or written to, as an object. (Replacing thee; originally as a mark of respect.)
senses.chinese: 受格代名詞，指被說話或書寫的對象；你。原本用來取代 thee，帶有敬意。

senses.english: (subject pronoun) The people spoken to or written to, as a subject. (Replacing ye.)
senses.chinese: 主格代名詞，指被說話或書寫對象所指的多個人；你們。用來取代 ye。

senses.english: (subject pronoun) The person spoken to or written to, as a subject. (Originally as a mark of respect.)
senses.chinese: 主格代名詞，指被說話或書寫的對象；你。最初帶有敬意。

example.english: You are all supposed to do as I tell you.
example.chinese: 你們都應該照我說的做。

senses.english: Determination; will power.
senses.chinese: 決心；意志力。

senses.english: To find a solution to (a problem).
senses.chinese: 找出問題的解決方法。

senses.english: To reduce to simple or intelligible notions; to make clear or certain; to unravel; to explain.
senses.chinese: 將事物釐清，使其簡明易懂或確定；解開；解釋。

senses.english: To make a firm decision to do something.
senses.chinese: 下定決心做某事。

example.english: I resolve to finish this work before I go home.
example.chinese: 我決心在回家前完成這項工作。

senses.english: A person who is running in an election.
senses.chinese: 參加選舉的人；候選人。

senses.english: A person who is applying for a job.
senses.chinese: 求職者；應徵者。

senses.english: A participant in an examination.
senses.chinese: 參加考試的人；考生。

senses.english: Something or somebody that may be suitable.
senses.chinese: 可能適合的事物或人選。

senses.english: Of a body in motion: the tendency of a body to maintain its inertial motion; the product of its mass and velocity.
senses.chinese: 運動物體維持慣性運動的性質；其質量與速度的乘積，即動量。

senses.english: The impetus, either of a body in motion, or of an idea or course of events; a moment.
senses.chinese: 運動物體、想法或事件進程向前發展的推力或勢頭。

senses.english: (law enforcement) A previous arrest or criminal conviction on someone's record.
senses.chinese: 執法用語，指某人紀錄中的前次逮捕或刑事定罪。

senses.english: In Bayesian inference, a prior probability distribution, one based on information or belief before additional data is collected.
senses.chinese: 貝葉斯推論中的事前機率分布，以取得額外資料前的資訊或信念為基礎。

senses.english: Advance; previous; coming before.
senses.chinese: 事先的；先前的；較早發生的。

senses.english: Previously.
senses.chinese: 先前；之前。

example.english: I had no prior knowledge you were coming.

senses.english: A person who invests money in order to make a profit.
senses.chinese: 為了獲利而投入資金的人。

skittish.gloss: 容易受驚的；反覆無常的

senses.english: Easily scared or startled; timid.
senses.chinese: 容易害怕或受驚的；膽怯的。

senses.english: Wanton; changeable; fickle
senses.chinese: 任性放縱的；多變的；反覆無常的。

senses.english: Difficult to manage; tricky.
senses.chinese: 難以操控或處理的；棘手的。

example.english: The cat likes people he knows, but he is skittish around strangers.
example.chinese: 這隻貓喜歡牠認識的人，但在陌生人身邊很容易受驚。

senses.english: To take back (a comment, etc); retract.
senses.chinese: 收回言論等；撤回。

senses.english: To remove, to stop providing (one's support, etc); to take out of service.
senses.chinese: 撤除或停止提供支持等；停止使用。

senses.english: To extract (money from an account).
senses.chinese: 從帳戶中提領金錢。

senses.english: To retreat.
senses.chinese: 撤退；退出。

senses.english: To consider the reasons for and against anything; to reflect.
senses.chinese: 考量某事正反兩面的理由；仔細思考。

senses.english: Done on purpose; intentional.
senses.chinese: 故意做的；蓄意的。

senses.english: Formed with deliberation; carefully considered; not sudden or rash.
senses.chinese: 經過深思熟慮形成的；審慎考量的；並非倉促或魯莽的。

senses.english: Not hasty or sudden; slow.
senses.chinese: 不匆忙或不突然的；從容緩慢的。

example.english: a deliberate opinion; a deliberate measure or result
example.chinese: 經過深思熟慮的意見；審慎考量的措施或結果
